verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook is a SaaS research product that could plausibly offer a developer API with interactive documentation, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only end-user features: source upload, grounded chat, Audio/Video Overviews, mind maps, flashcards and sharing. Nothing in it mentions an API, an API reference, or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
